title: Sausage Balls
description: A simple and delicious three-ingredient sausage ball recipe that can also be made into mini muffins.

ingredients.item: sharp cheddar cheese (can substitute Colby Jack)
Red Lobster Cheddar Bay Biscuit Mix (or Bisquick)

steps: Mix all ingredients together until a big ball consistency is achieved.
Form into small balls or mini muffin tops.
Place on an aluminum pan and bake at 350°F (175°C) for about 20 minutes for balls or 25-30 minutes for mini muffins.
Melt a quarter stick of butter and baste the cooked sausage balls or muffins while hot.
Let cool for 10 minutes to soak up the butter before serving.
Optional: work a butter knife around the outside to easily remove from the pan.
notes:
These sausage balls can also be made into mini muffins for quicker baking.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1BhZQDeNX1/
